question: Does equal-budget high-rate sampling inside each annotated clip improve sweeping and reperfusion recognition?

sampling_arms.uniform: 36 bin-centre frames across the complete clip
sampling_arms.three_windows: for clips longer than 3 seconds, three 1-second windows centered at 1/6, 1/2 and 5/6 of the clip, with 12 bin-centre frames per window; shorter clips use uniform sampling

evaluation_scope: Same frozen train and validation manifests for both sampling arms; no independent test is read in this pilot
